data.title: Bitcoin Just Crashed Toward $66,000. History Says the Worst May Not Be Over
data.description: Bitcoin's slide has bruised holders, but three past cycles and a 2022 double bottom suggest the first flush rarely ends the pain. Three catalysts and two price lines will decide whether the old highs come back or the floor drops again.
